title: Lesson 24: Performance: Query Optimization, Selective SOQL, Indexes, and Caching
description: How a query becomes fast: the selectivity thresholds the optimizer uses to decide whether an index is worth it, how to write SOQL that the optimizer will actually treat well, how to measure and index, and Platform Cache as the lever that skips the query entirely.
